success_shaped_failure.name: success_shaped_failure
success_shaped_failure.predicate: Does a reachable failure path produce a return value, metric, event, or state that represents successful authoritative work?
success_shaped_failure.required_context: Target, failure contract, and relevant callers/callees or metric semantics.
success_shaped_failure.positive: A failed authoritative query becomes an empty successful result; successful-egress telemetry fires before a failed send.
success_shaped_failure.negative: A documented optional cache miss falls back to the authoritative source; metrics explicitly count attempted work.

invalid_state_accommodation.name: invalid_state_accommodation
invalid_state_accommodation.predicate: Does internal code accommodate representations excluded by an established input contract?
invalid_state_accommodation.required_context: Normalization boundary, target, and internal input contract.
invalid_state_accommodation.positive: After normalization into a struct, private helpers independently accept nil, atom-key maps, and string-key maps.
invalid_state_accommodation.negative: A public compatibility adapter intentionally accepts several representations.

test_claim_gap.name: test_claim_gap
test_claim_gap.predicate: Can an obvious incorrect implementation of the behavior covered by this test or supplied suite pass all its assertions?
test_claim_gap.required_context: Test/suite, implementation under test, fixtures and assertion helpers.
test_claim_gap.positive: Cookie object-key tests use only keys requiring no encoding; removing key encoding survives. A missing-key branch has no distinguishing assertion.
test_claim_gap.negative: A narrowly described smoke test; assertions delegated to helpers; a test uses discriminating boundary inputs.

semantic_duplicate.name: semantic_duplicate
semantic_duplicate.predicate: Does the target independently reimplement a supplied existing domain operation without a meaningful contract difference?
semantic_duplicate.required_context: Both implementations and their consumers or contracts.
semantic_duplicate.positive: A test repeats the same server/user/backend setup already supplied by a canonical helper.
semantic_duplicate.negative: Similar operations enforce different policies or deliberately coexist during migration.

process_without_runtime_reason.name: process_without_runtime_reason
process_without_runtime_reason.predicate: Does a process merely organize code without needed state ownership, coordination, isolation, concurrency limits, or lifecycle?
process_without_runtime_reason.required_context: Whole process module, supervision/ownership and callers.
process_without_runtime_reason.positive: A GenServer serializes independent pure calculations solely for namespacing.
process_without_runtime_reason.negative: A coordinator owns resources and timers even if it also exposes a simple getter.

policy_free_abstraction.name: policy_free_abstraction
policy_free_abstraction.predicate: Does the target add indirection or configurability without a distinct contract, supported variation, or useful boundary?
policy_free_abstraction.required_context: Layer, consumers, configuration and intended policy.
policy_free_abstraction.positive: An internal option and several helpers only route to the same required export policy.
policy_free_abstraction.negative: A stable public facade, external adapter, or useful test seam with one implementation.

derived_state_drift.name: derived_state_drift
derived_state_drift.predicate: Are two representations of the same fact independently maintained with a visible path that can make them disagree?
derived_state_drift.required_context: Initialization and all relevant update paths.
derived_state_drift.positive: A removal callback updates the collection but leaves its stored count unchanged.
derived_state_drift.negative: A consistently updated body-length accumulator avoids repeatedly traversing accumulated data; a deliberate historical snapshot has different semantics.

disguised_state_machine.name: disguised_state_machine
disguised_state_machine.predicate: Do independently stored booleans encode mutually constrained states of one domain concept with reachable meaningless combinations?
disguised_state_machine.positive: Loading, loaded and failed flags can simultaneously remain true for one operation.
disguised_state_machine.negative: Independent feature capabilities or flags with separate meanings.

timing_instead_of_synchronization.name: timing_instead_of_synchronization
timing_instead_of_synchronization.predicate: Does elapsed time stand in for observing completion or establishing required ordering?
timing_instead_of_synchronization.required_context: Sleep/timer, asynchronous operation, and test/lifecycle contract.
timing_instead_of_synchronization.positive: Sleep before checking a worker write and assume it has finished.
timing_instead_of_synchronization.negative: A delayed server deliberately triggers a receive-timeout test; actual debounce or expiry behavior is under test.

presentation_only_authorization.name: presentation_only_authorization
presentation_only_authorization.predicate: Is a restriction confined to rendering/navigation while the corresponding server action lacks equivalent authorization?
presentation_only_authorization.required_context: UI restriction, action/event handler, and authorization in called context functions.
presentation_only_authorization.positive: Hide a delete button but accept arbitrary delete events without a server-side check.
presentation_only_authorization.negative: The action calls an authorization-enforcing context or scoped lookup.

framework_reimplementation.name: framework_reimplementation
framework_reimplementation.predicate: Does custom code duplicate an available project framework facility without materially different semantics?
framework_reimplementation.required_context: Custom code, installed dependency version, and supplied facility documentation.
framework_reimplementation.positive: A parallel casting and validation pipeline duplicates the supplied Ecto changeset contract.
framework_reimplementation.negative: The required semantics differ or the installed dependency lacks the feature.

semantic_comment_noise.name: semantic_comment_noise
semantic_comment_noise.predicate: Does an implementation comment only paraphrase obvious adjacent code, adding no rationale, invariant, warning, or constraint?
semantic_comment_noise.positive: A comment repeats that fetch_users fetches users.
semantic_comment_noise.negative: A comment explains why ordering matters, why a simpler implementation fails, or documents a public API.

avoidable_repeated_traversal.name: avoidable_repeated_traversal
avoidable_repeated_traversal.predicate: Does a loop repeatedly traverse growing accumulated data to recover information maintainable locally without changing behavior?
avoidable_repeated_traversal.required_context: Loop initialization, recursive transitions, length limits, and underlying traversal semantics.
avoidable_repeated_traversal.positive: Compute the length of the entire accumulated iodata at every received chunk.
avoidable_repeated_traversal.negative: Maintain a consistently updated length counter or compute a genuinely new value.

redundant_wrapper.name: redundant_wrapper
redundant_wrapper.predicate: Can the marked wrapper be replaced by its input without changing any output, exception, or other observable behavior?
redundant_wrapper.required_context: Complete wrapper, patterns and exhaustive alternatives.
redundant_wrapper.positive: An exhaustive case returns every matched value unchanged including its catch-all.
redundant_wrapper.negative: A non-exhaustive identity case raises on unmatched input; map reconstruction drops extra keys; a result tuple is unwrapped.
